DROP TABLE [BNKM].[CustomerMaritalStatus]
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE TABLE [BNKM].[CustomerMaritalStatus]
( 
	[CustomerId] [varchar](50) NOT NULL,
	[PeriodStartDate] [date]  NOT NULL,
	[PeriodEndDate] [date]  NULL,
	[MaritalStatusId] [int]  NULL,
	[CustomerMaritalStatusNote] [varchar](2048)  NULL,
	[SourceCode] [varchar](20)  NULL,
	[FinancialInstitutionId] [varchar](20)   NOT NULL,
	[WorkFlowId] [bigint]  NULL,
	[TaskRunId] [bigint]  NULL,
	[InsertDttm] [datetime]  NULL
)
WITH
(
	DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
	CLUSTERED INDEX 
	(
		[CustomerId] ASC,
		[CustomerMaritalStatusNote] ASC,
		[MaritalStatusId] ASC,
		[PeriodEndDate] ASC,
		[PeriodStartDate] ASC
	)
)
GO
